t: The Site Mantia Hi-Vis Waistcoat is a lightweight safety garment designed to increase visibility in low-light environments. This navy high-visibility vest features 50mm reflective tape across the chest and shoulders to ensure trade professionals remain visible at a distance. Ideal for warehouse staff, delivery drivers, and site workers operating in medium-risk situations, the waistcoat is constructed from 100% breathable polyester fabric to maintain comfort throughout the workday. A simple hook and loop front fastening provides a secure fit, while the machine-washable material allows for easy maintenance.
b: Breathable 100% Polyester Fabric Keeps Wearers Cool
Hook & Loop Front Fastening Ensures Easy Wear
Lightweight Design Minimises Fatigue during Long Shifts
Pocket-Free Design Prevents Snagging Hazards on Site
Unisex Design Fits Men & Women Comfortably
Machine Washable Fabric Simplifies Cleaning & Care
